name: EvalSpec
source: Table 2 of 'LLM Evaluation Discrepancies And How To Prevent Them'

fields.name: scoring_mode
fields.description: One of: log-likelihood, generation, preference, execution

fields.name: harness_name
fields.description: Software or evaluation framework used to run the benchmark

fields.name: evaluation_timestamp
fields.description: Date and time at which the evaluation was run (ISO 8601)

fields.name: prompt_template_hash
fields.description: SHA-256 of the fully rendered prompt (task template, system instruction, chat template)

fields.name: answer_parser_version
fields.description: Answer-extractor or parser id and version

fields.name: judge_prompt_hash
fields.description: SHA-256 of the canonicalized judge prompt + rubric

fields.name: judge_score_rule
fields.description: Procedure for converting judge response into score

fields.name: provenance_url
fields.description: Link to raw outputs, log or evaluation artifacts

fields.name: compute_hours
fields.description: Total GPU time, measured in device-hours
